title: Low Earth Orbit Expansion

summary: Full reusability drops launch prices by an order of magnitude.

title: Water Recycling

content.challenge: Long-duration reliability without resupply.

title: Mars Exploration

title: Interplanetary Economy
summary: Trade between planets and moons.

content.detail: Volatiles from the outer system, metals from asteroids, and manufactured goods from orbit create the first market that spans worlds — priced in delta-v as much as currency.

title: Space Elevators
summary: Massive launch infrastructure.

content.detail: A tether from the surface to beyond geostationary orbit turns launch into an elevator ride. Feasible on the Moon and Mars long before Earth.

title: Orbital Cities
summary: O'Neill Cylinders and rotating habitats.

content.detail: Kilometres-long spinning cylinders with rivers, weather and full gravity — homes designed rather than inherited.

title: Terraforming
summary: Long-term planetary engineering.

content.detail: Thickening atmospheres, warming surfaces and seeding biospheres across centuries. The slowest and most ambitious project imaginable.

title: AI Civilization
summary: Robotic construction throughout the Solar System.

content.detail: Self-replicating machine fleets prospect, refine and build for decades before a single human arrives.

title: Dyson Swarm
summary: Large-scale solar energy collection.

content.detail: Millions of independent collectors orbiting the Sun, harvesting a growing fraction of its output for a civilization with no energy ceiling.

title: Interstellar Exploration
summary: Probes, then people, beyond our Solar System.

content.detail: Laser-driven sails reach nearby stars within a human lifetime; crewed ships follow only once we can carry an ecosystem with us.
